summary: The async_status module reports the status of an asynchronous task and supports Windows; since ansible-core 2.19 the started and finished values are booleans rather than 1/0.
questions: How do I check whether a background async task has finished?
Why did my check for finished == 1 stop working after upgrading Ansible?
Does async_status work on Windows hosts?

answer_card.title: Check async job status
answer_card.answer_md: `ansible.builtin.async_status` gets the status of an async task (also on Windows). Since ansible-core 2.19, `started` and `finished` return `True`/`False` instead of `1`/`0`, so prefer `until: job_result is finished`.
